about: Prompts for background beds under narration (paste into Stable Audio or any generator; the dashboard has Copy buttons under Sound → Music stem). Every bed: instrumental, steady, no drops or solos that fight the voice, loops cleanly. `style` = the video style it suits (any = both).
common: Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Background music for a spoken documentary: steady level, sparse mid-range so the narrator's voice sits on top, no sudden drops, builds or solos. Clean studio mix. Seamless loop, ends on the same chord it starts on.

prompts.prompt: 1960s spy jazz combo, cool and understated: walking upright bass, brushed snare, soft vibraphone chords, muted trumpet playing a short motif every eight bars. D minor, 92 BPM, relaxed swing.

1960s spy thriller jazz, tense and stealthy: pizzicato upright bass ostinato, ride cymbal, low organ stabs, surf guitar twang on bar one of each phrase, vibraphone tremolo. E minor, 100 BPM, cool swing.
Late-night film noir jazz: slow walking bass, brushes, smoky muted trumpet, dark piano voicings with flat ninths, a little tape hiss. C minor, 84 BPM, slow and suspicious.
1960s spy caper chase, energetic but controlled: fast walking bass, bongos and ride, brass section stabs on the downbeats, surf guitar riff, hammond organ. A minor, 112 BPM.
Cool 1960s spy jazz in a major key, confident and satisfied: walking bass, brushes, warm vibraphone melody, horn section swells at phrase ends. F major, 96 BPM.
Minimal modern documentary bed: soft felt piano arpeggio, warm analog synth pad, gentle sub bass, light clicky percussion like a pencil tapping. D major, 90 BPM, thoughtful and clean.
Bright minimal electronic for an explainer: plucked marimba and kalimba pattern, soft side-chained pad, tight kick and shaker, round bass. G major, 100 BPM, playful but focused.
Cool futuristic tension bed: pulsing synth bass in sixteenths, glassy arpeggiator, filtered pad, subtle ticking hi-hats, no melody. A minor, 96 BPM, precise and uneasy.
Upbeat modern explainer groove: punchy kick and clap, bouncy synth bass, staccato strings, bright plucks. C major, 110 BPM, confident momentum.
Warm lo-fi hip hop bed: dusty Rhodes chords, soft boom-bap drums low in the mix, mellow bass, light vinyl crackle. E-flat major, 82 BPM.
Investigative documentary tension: low cello ostinato, ticking clock-like percussion, distant piano notes, subtle synth drone. D minor, 90 BPM, curious and suspenseful, never loud.
Uplifting ending bed: bright piano chords, warm strings, steady light drums, gentle build to a confident final chord. B-flat major, 100 BPM.
